tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and card fill. Most of the screen is this.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Inset areas on surface: footers, chips, citation tags, empty states, table headers.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, values and primary text on surface and canvas (17:1 light, 17:1 dark).

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Running text on surface and canvas (10:1 light, 13:1 dark).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions and inactive nav on surface and canvas (4.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Only for de-emphasised text at 24px or larger, e.g. the grey second half of a headline (3.7:1 light, 4:1 dark). Never for small text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative: never the only thing separating meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of outline buttons, inputs and selectable chips. Decorative boundary (1.5:1); the control's label identifies it.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the single primary action when no accent layer is applied.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on primary.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Status only: eligible, refunded, success. Text on good-tint (4.8:1 light, 9.4:1 dark). Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: good-tint
tokens.usage: Background of good status chips.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Status only: watch out, partial, needs attention. Text on warn-tint (4.8:1 light, 9.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Background of warn status chips and draft banners.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Status only: critical, not eligible, forfeited. Text on bad-tint (5.9:1 light, 6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: bad-tint
tokens.usage: Background of bad status chips.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Optional accent layer. Links, active nav, selected options, focus ring (4.7:1 light, 7:1 dark on surface). Without the layer, use ink.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Optional accent layer. Link text and selected-option text on accent-tint (6.6:1 light, 8.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Optional accent layer. Background of the active nav item, selected options and the recommended row.

tokens.name: accent-from
tokens.usage: Optional accent layer. Start of the 135° gradient on primary buttons and the one key figure per page.

tokens.name: accent-to
tokens.usage: Optional accent layer. End of the 135° gradient. White text holds 4.7:1 on it in both themes.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on the accent gradient.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing hero headline, one per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page title. Put the secondary half in faint.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section titles and the key verdict line.
styles.sample: Eligible for government and private colleges

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Small headings inside cards and lists.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tell us about yourself once and we'll check every rule against it.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense lists, table cells, card text.
styles.sample: Pay the deposit tier that matches the colleges you want.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Field hints, eyebrow labels, metadata in muted.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Citation tags and tiny status text only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps, chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row padding, gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding (compact), page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card inner padding on desktop, gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page header and content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero padding and major page breaks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Citation tags and tiny labels.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows, status chips (6px reads the same).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and page sections. Never larger.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and progress bars only. No pill buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Primary buttons only. Cards use a line border, not a shadow.
